issues.legal_issue: A pending suit for possession of land abates when it concerns land rights that must be adjudicated in ongoing consolidation operations.
material_facts: The suit sought possession on the basis that the plaintiff held the relevant land right and that the defendant was a trespasser; the defendant disputed the plaintiff’s claim and asserted tenancy rights.
The land was brought under consolidation operations while the appeal from the possession decree was pending.

The consolidation authorities were empowered to determine land rights and related disputes, and the abatement provision preserved the affected parties’ ability to pursue those rights before those authorities.
issues.conclusion: The amended abatement provision covered the possession suit because deciding the possession claim required adjudication of rights or interests in the land; the suit and the appeal arising from it therefore abated.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 5(2)(a) of the Uttar Pradesh Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1953, as amended, pending suits and proceedings concerning rights or interests in land, and other rights that can or ought to be determined under the Act, abate upon the required order. Although possession suits are not expressly named in the amended provision, a possession claim falls within it when deciding possession necessarily requires adjudication of rights or interests in the land. Sections 3, 9, 11, 11A, 24, 28, 40, 48 and 49 support the conclusion that the consolidation authorities can determine disputes of this kind; section 5(2)(b) preserves the parties’ ability to raise the disputed rights before those authorities. The underlying possession claim was brought under section 209 of the Uttar Pradesh Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: appeal_in_possession_suit and consolidation_operations_notified and possession_claim_requires_land_rights_adjudication and dispute_is_within_consolidation_authority

predicates.appeal_in_possession_suit: An appeal was pending from a judgment in a suit seeking possession of land.
predicates.consolidation_operations_notified: The area containing the disputed land was brought under consolidation operations.
predicates.possession_claim_requires_land_rights_ad: Determining the possession claim required the court to decide the parties’ rights or interests in the land.
predicates.dispute_is_within_consolidation_authorit: The dispute concerned rights that the consolidation authorities were empowered to determine.

issues.definition: When an appeal in a possession suit concerns land brought under consolidation and resolving possession requires determination of rights within the consolidation authorities’ remit, the pending suit abates.

issues.legal_issue: A State law that abates a pending suit concerning land rights within the State Legislature’s competence does not thereby oust the Supreme Court’s jurisdiction over an appeal from that suit.
material_facts: A special-leave appeal was pending before the Supreme Court when the State amended the law to provide for abatement of qualifying pending suits and proceedings.
The amendment concerned land-rights matters within the State Legislature’s jurisdiction and declared the underlying suit abated.
The Supreme Court treated the amendment as a subsequent event and disposed of the appeal because the underlying suit had abated.
issues.conclusion: The amendment did not affect or oust the Supreme Court’s jurisdiction and was not ultra vires on that ground; the Court took account of the subsequent amendment and disposed of the appeal as abated.
issues.legal_principle: A State Legislature may legislate on matters within its jurisdiction and provide that a suit pending in a court within its area abates. When such a law applies to the underlying suit, the Supreme Court’s recognition of the resulting abatement is taking account of a subsequent event, not the State Legislature legislating to affect the Supreme Court’s jurisdiction. The judgment refers to the legislative entries in the Seventh Schedule but identifies no particular entry or earlier case.

rule.if: special_leave_appeal_pending and state_law_regulates_local_land_rights and state_law_abates_underlying_suit and apex_court_considers_subsequent_law

predicates.special_leave_appeal_pending: An appeal granted special leave was pending before the Supreme Court.
predicates.state_law_regulates_local_land_rights: The State legislation concerned land-rights matters within the State Legislature’s jurisdiction.
predicates.state_law_abates_underlying_suit: The State legislation provided for abatement of the pending suit from which the appeal arose.
predicates.apex_court_considers_subsequent_law: The Supreme Court took account of the later legislation in deciding the pending appeal.

issues.definition: When a pending special-leave appeal arises from a suit abated under State legislation within the State Legislature’s jurisdiction, the Supreme Court’s recognition of that subsequent event does not oust its jurisdiction.
